title: Terrain workshop — shared DEM/SDF and distance caches
iteration: 2026-10-05 / playable home DEM, cached normals and satellite pages
goal: Inspect the shared DEM/SDF transition with key 5 and its elevated view with key 6. Fly closer and farther to inspect mesh, surface-normal and satellite detail. First visits may generate caches; repeat visits should reuse them. Keys 1–4 return to the existing workshop. F8 begins/ends hitch capture. Existing Warthog speed tuning and streaming safeguards remain in place.
changes: Shared DEM/SDF now extends playable terrain to about 2 km from the origin, preserving the original terrain within 768 m. Fine collision, distance meshes and cached surface normals share the terrain source. Satellite pages select native, half or quarter resolution by projected pixel size and persist on disk. Cold generation takes longer; repeat views reuse caches. Keys 5/6 show the exterior transition/overview; 1–4 return to the workshop. General exterior cave seams, some exterior authoring height limits and airborne streaming remain follow-up work.
controls:
Mountain infill: arm button, then one terrain click. Configure radius, height, seed, noise, wavelength, octaves, erosion strengths/iterations and wind heading. To revise: select mountain, adjust, Apply.
Trees: Paint fir trees, hold LMB; main radius controls size. Density, height, slope and seed have labelled settings. Erase removes overlapping painted patches. Save explicitly. Undo restores edits. 600 resident painted-tree cap.
Raise/Lower: hold LMB. RMB + WASD fly; Space/Ctrl rise/fall. Wheel zoom; Shift-wheel size. F1 play/edit with readiness progress. B in play throws grenades. F8 log markers; F3 chunks; F2 briefing.
